name: Photo Grid Reveal
summary: Build an editable 3-by-7 photo and video gallery with sequential reveals and a shared monochrome-to-color switch.

compatibility.selects: Requires a panel host exposing the app-owned TimelineMutation service for Image placement; public run_script for video/audio overlays, effects, transforms, gap-backed Drafts, media import, and commit. Retest after Selects updates.

de.name: Photo Grid Reveal
de.summary: Ein 3×7-Raster füllt sich nacheinander; danach wechseln alle Felder von Schwarzweiß zu Farbe. Wählen Sie für jedes Feld ein Foto oder Video.

en.name: Photo Grid Reveal
en.summary: A 3 × 7 gallery fills in order, then all tiles switch from monochrome to color. Assign a photo or video to each tile when creating a Draft.

es.name: Photo Grid Reveal
es.summary: Una cuadrícula de 3×7 se llena en orden y luego cambia de blanco y negro a color. Asigna una foto o vídeo a cada celda.

fr.name: Photo Grid Reveal
fr.summary: Une grille de 3×7 se remplit dans l’ordre, puis passe du noir et blanc à la couleur. Choisissez une photo ou vidéo par case.

it.name: Photo Grid Reveal
it.summary: Una griglia 3×7 si riempie in ordine, poi passa dal bianco e nero al colore. Assegna una foto o un video a ogni riquadro.

ja.name: Photo Grid Reveal
ja.summary: 3列×7行を順番に表示し、すべての枠がモノクロからカラーに切り替わります。各枠に写真または動画を指定します。

ko.name: Photo Grid Reveal
ko.summary: 3열 × 7행이 차례로 채워지고 전체가 흑백에서 컬러로 바뀝니다. 새 편집본의 21칸에 사진과 영상을 각각 지정합니다.

pt.name: Photo Grid Reveal
pt.summary: Uma grelha 3×7 preenche-se em ordem e muda de preto e branco para cor. Atribua uma foto ou vídeo a cada célula.

tr.name: Photo Grid Reveal
tr.summary: 3×7 ızgara sırayla dolar, sonra tüm kutular siyah beyazdan renge geçer. Her kutuya fotoğraf veya video atayın.

zh.name: Photo Grid Reveal
zh.summary: 3列×7行依次显示，随后所有格子从黑白切换到彩色。为每个格子指定照片或视频。

inputs.label: Photos
inputs.hint: 15 photos for the still tiles, in order.

inputs.label: Videos
inputs.hint: 6 videos for the moving tiles, in order.
inputs.query: people moving or a lively moment

prepare: Python 3 on this Mac, to hold short videos on their last frame
